description: This file defines core interfaces for asynchronous streaming in the Orleans framework, specifically the IAsyncStream and IAsyncStream<T> interfaces, which facilitate distributed pub-sub and reactive stream functionalities.

classes.name: IAsyncStream<T>
classes.description: An interface representing an asynchronous stream with methods for managing subscriptions and stream properties.

classes.name: IAsyncStream
classes.description: An interface representing a distributed rendezvous point for producers and consumers, providing properties like rewindability, provider name, and stream identifier.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptionHandles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active subscription handles created by the caller for this stream.
